groups.sidesDesc: Turn a side off to keep its transparent border (e.g. to keep a character's feet on the bottom edge).

alphaThreshold.label: Alpha threshold
alphaThreshold.desc: Pixels with alpha at or below this value count as empty. 0 trims only fully transparent pixels.

margin.label: Margin
margin.desc: Keeps up to this many pixels around the content on trimmed sides.

emptyBehavior.label: Fully transparent images
emptyBehavior.desc: What to do when an image has no visible pixel.

snap.label: Snap trimmed size
snap.desc: Grows the trimmed area (centered on the content) to a multiple of 4 or a power of two.

writeOffsets.label: Write offsets JSON
writeOffsets.desc: Saves <output>.json next to each image with the source size and trim rectangle, so the original pivot can be restored.

sizes.hint: Trimmed sizes depend on each image's pixels. Previewed images are measured automatically.
